_note: The Standing track. Only the box the booklet names is entered: setup and
every reassignment put a Grognard in '0 (5)', and the General/Marechal
'checkValue' is the number in parentheses - the '(S)' used in
'battleMultiplier' is an ASSUMPTION: the app multiplies the Combat card's
N and G by it and then clamps to [0 .. 2x the card value], which is how it
reads 'modified by S -> Min-Max [0..2x]'. 1 is neutral. Confirm this
against the rulebook before trusting battle results.
'rollToIndex' maps the 1D10 of 'Roll 1D10 on Standing' to a box; while it
is empty the app asks which box the roll lands in.
